name: 476. Offline runs reach loopback only; Bedrock reaches the fixture through its endpoint override (offline egress)
description: TXE-7083, local fixture regression with no live provider calls. Start provider-error-fixture.mjs and an isolated gateway on provider-error-fixture.config.json, both under scripts/test-offline.sh, and run newman under it too (README: Offline runs and egress). Bedrock ignores network_config.base_url: its host comes from the region, which is how a TXE-7080 fixture run reached AWS. Row 1 covers Bedrock the documented way, with bedrock_key_config.endpoints.runtime on the fixture's TLS listener and network_config.insecure_skip_verify. Rows 2 and 3 point a provider at TEST-NET-3 (203.0.113.10, never routed): an offline gateway refuses the dial before connecting and names the address, for Bedrock's net/http client and for a base_url provider on the shared fasthttp dialer. Against a gateway not started under the runner, rows 2 and 3 fail (and make run-provider-harness-test refuses to start).
